atlases.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. Production source sprite atlas for an original chibi fantasy RPG HUD with dark olive panels and antique-gold buttons. Make exactly EIGHT independent square-area pictograms arranged in a strictly even invisible grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, widescreen 2:1 canvas. Every motif centered in its own cell with generous consistent margin, occupying 60-74% cell width/height, far from cell boundaries. Each graphic is a polished hand-painted 2D cel shaded icon, large forms thick dark outline, sharp clear edges, visually distinct at 32px, bright highlights restrained detail. True transparent background for entire atlas and between motifs, no black plate, no badge, no tile/card frame, no shadow, no letters, no text, no marker numbers or grid lines. Maintain ordered reading order left to right.
One atlas of swordsman icons. Cell 1 is top-left and cell 8 is bottom-right.
1. one silver broadsword with one diagonal gold cutting arc.
2. one horizontal silver blade inside a circular double gold slash.
3. a sword striking downward into two chunky cracked bronze rocks, warm orange fracture.
4. one massive vertical sacred gold sword falling from a bright narrow beam, two smaller ghost swords.
5. silver medieval shield with solid warm golden rim.
6. an armored fist framed by thick orange flame.
7. large crimson blood drop being pulled into a small claw-like silhouette.
8. one broad silver breastplate with a small golden heart in center.
